integrity: The powerful-core decomposition, fixed-support finiteness, and the published two-prime classification are treated as prior inputs. The claimed contribution is the fixed-prime-factor asymptotic hierarchy and its explicit leading constant and consecutive-layer ratio; finite computation is corroborative only.
limitations: The asymptotic is for each fixed number of distinct prime factors; no uniformity for growing r is claimed.
No effective error term is claimed.
The 1978 primary article for the two-prime classification was located bibliographically but not materially read; the exact theorem was checked in a later handbook and sequence literature.
The theorem does not classify powerful exponential-perfect cores with three or more prime factors.
title: Fixed-prime-factor layers of exponential-perfect numbers
